modules.name: 4-Card Hero Campaign Hub
modules.description: Verifies the simultaneous display of 4 distinct promotional cards replacing traditional auto-rotating slides.

tests.name: Card 1: Special Offers & Flash Deals
tests.expected: Contains "Special Offers", discount badge, and quick deal showcase
tests.actual: Card 1 rendered with live discount rates and deal selector

tests.name: Card 2: Upcoming Sale Days & Live Countdown
tests.expected: Contains "Upcoming Sales", live countdown clock, and event roadmap
tests.actual: Card 2 rendered with countdown blocks (Days, Hours, Mins, Secs) and alert trigger

tests.name: Card 3: Weekly Lucky Draws (Tiered Entry)
tests.expected: Contains Platinum (>₹5,000), Gold (₹2,500+), Silver (₹1,000+) tier snapshots
tests.actual: Card 3 rendered with all 3 tier snapshots and Interactive Draw Wheel trigger

tests.name: Card 4: Grand Bumper Draw (Brand JUDES Exclusive)
tests.expected: Contains Brand JUDES exclusivity badge, SUV/Trip/Cash jackpots, and shop button
tests.actual: Card 4 rendered with luxury jackpot tiers and Brand JUDES direct link

modules.name: JudesAI Shopping Concierge
modules.description: Validates floating launcher orb, intent brain, draw tier optimizer, and in-chat 1-click purchasing.

tests.name: Floating AI Launcher Orb & Smart Teaser Bubble
tests.expected: Rendered at bottom-6 right-6 with gradient pulse and unread notification badge
tests.actual: Launcher orb present with teaser bubble "Need styling advice or Lucky Draw tips? Ask JudesAI"

tests.name: Brain Intent: Lucky Draw Tier Advice
tests.expected: Computes cart threshold and advises on Platinum, Gold, or Silver tickets
tests.actual: Intent brain correctly identifies draw keywords and returns qualifying spend thresholds

tests.name: Brain Intent: Brand JUDES Bumper Matchmaker
tests.expected: Filters catalog and recommends Brand JUDES products with bumper tickets
tests.actual: Intent brain accurately surfaces SonicPro, Cashmere, and Sella tote with bumper tags

tests.name: Brain Intent: Special Offers & Promo Codes
tests.expected: Recommends active coupons (WELCOME10) with 1-click apply action
tests.actual: Intent brain generates coupon card with WELCOME10 and 1-click apply handler

modules.name: Currency & Geolocation System

tests.name: Location Detection API (/api/detect-location)
tests.expected: Returns HTTP 200 with countryCode, currency, and symbol
tests.actual: Returned valid location payload: Detected (USD)

tests.name: US Dollar Formatting ($)
tests.actual: $299.00 (Standard US locale)

tests.name: Indian Rupee Formatting (₹) & Lucky Draw Thresholds
tests.expected: ₹25,864 with ₹5,000 Platinum / ₹2,500 Gold / ₹1,000 Silver criteria
tests.actual: Exchange rate 86.5x applied cleanly with localized rupee formatting

tests.name: EUR, GBP, and JPY Conversion Rates
tests.actual: All 7 currency rates mapped and verified in mock-data.ts and StoreContext

modules.name: Product Catalog & Search Matrix
modules.description: Verifies category navigation, brand filters, stock filters, and instant search.

tests.name: 6 Departments Navigation
tests.expected: Electronics, Apparel, Footwear, Leather Goods, Home & Living, Beauty
tests.actual: All 6 curated department categories present with correct slugs

tests.name: Brand JUDES In-House Filter
tests.expected: Filters products tagged with brand "JUDES"
tests.actual: Brand filter correctly isolates in-house products eligible for Bumper Draw

tests.name: Search Overlay (Cmd+K / Search Icon)
tests.expected: Instant filter matching titles, categories, and tags
tests.actual: Search overlay input mounted with ⌘K shortcut and instant results list

modules.name: Slide-Over Cart & Gamification
modules.description: Validates cart subtotal math, free shipping meter, promo engine, and coin redemption.

tests.name: Subtotal & Tax Calculations
tests.expected: Accurate sum of item (price * quantity) - promo discount + shipping
tests.actual: calculateCartSummary computes exact math across all quantities and promos

tests.name: Free Shipping Progress Meter ($99 / ₹5,000)
tests.expected: Dynamic percentage bar showing remaining spend for complimentary delivery
tests.actual: Meter updates in real time with celebration state when goal is reached

tests.name: Promo Code Engine (WELCOME10, FREESHIP, VIPCLUB)
tests.expected: WELCOME10: 10% off; FREESHIP: $0 shipping; VIPCLUB: 15% off
tests.actual: All 3 promo codes successfully validated and deducted from cart summary

tests.name: Direct JudesCoins Redemption
tests.expected: Redeem coins directly for checkout discount (100 coins = $1.00)
tests.actual: Coin redemption deducts discount and decrements user coin balance

modules.name: Checkout & Ticket Generation
modules.description: Tests multi-step checkout, shipping methods, payments, and automated lucky draw ticket generation.

tests.name: Shipping Methods (Standard, Express, Overnight)
tests.expected: Standard ($0 over $99), Express ($25), Overnight ($45)
tests.actual: Shipping options rendered with dynamic price updates on selection

tests.name: Payment Gateways (Card, UPI, COD, JudesCoins)
tests.expected: Secure selection with instant order validation
tests.actual: All 4 payment options supported with security encryption badges

tests.name: Automated Lucky Draw Ticket Generator
tests.expected: Generates verified alphanumeric ticket tokens based on cart tier (>₹5k = Platinum)
tests.actual: Tickets generated with serial numbers (e.g. PLAT-78942-NY) stored on Order object

tests.name: Order Confirmation & Live Tracking Map
tests.expected: Displays order receipt, ticket vouchers, delivery tracking timeline, and confetti
tests.actual: Order confirmation page renders interactive tracking map and draw vouchers

modules.name: Lucky Draw & Gamification Hub
modules.description: Validates interactive spin wheel, prize claims, winner ticker, and mystery vault.

tests.name: Interactive Wheel of Fortune
tests.expected: Spin wheel with realistic easing animation and sound effects
tests.actual: Interactive canvas wheel with 8 prize segments and ticket deduction

tests.name: Recent Winners Live Ticker
tests.expected: Displays recent verified winners with avatar, city, prize, and draw tier
tests.actual: Ticker animates recent winners (iPhone 16 Pro, Apple Watch, Sony XM5)

tests.name: Bumper Draw Rules & Season Timeline
tests.expected: Details 6–12 month grand draw, Brand JUDES qualifier, and luxury car jackpot
tests.actual: Bumper Draw section renders rules, luxury SUV jackpot, and eligibility FAQ

modules.name: Customer Profile & VIP Loyalty Club
modules.description: Validates tiered VIP statuses (Silver, Gold, Black), JudesCoins balance, and staking.

tests.name: Tiered VIP Multipliers (Silver 1x, Gold 1.5x, Black 2x)
tests.expected: Calculates spend progress toward next VIP tier with progress bar
tests.actual: VIP progress bar dynamically displays remaining spend to Black tier

tests.name: Daily Mystery Box (Streak Gamification)
tests.expected: Allows daily claims up to 10 JudesCoins with consecutive streak tracking
tests.actual: Daily vault modal allows 1 claim per 24 hours and updates streak count

tests.name: 1-Click Re-Order from Past History
tests.expected: Re-adds all items from previous order into active cart in 1 click
tests.actual: reorderItems action successfully repopulates cart with identical items and variants

modules.name: Admin Command Center & Dual Console
modules.description: Validates security gatekeeper, inventory management, price overrides, and draw controls.

tests.name: Master PIN Lock Screen (4748)
tests.expected: Locks console until master PIN 4748 is authenticated
tests.actual: Secure lock screen active with 4-digit PIN verification and session expiration

tests.name: Live Stock & Price Adjustments
tests.expected: Real-time state updates to product prices and stock quantities
tests.actual: updateProductStock and updateProductPrice immediately propagate to StoreContext

tests.name: Manual / Scheduled Draw Execution
tests.expected: Admin can trigger Platinum/Gold/Silver draws and generate winner certificates
tests.actual: triggerAdminDraw picks verified winners from eligible pool and records certificate
